answer: Put every newcomer's work on a public mesa ledger as a comet trail. They register one key, then finish 20 client-signed jobs over 45 days, no gap over 72 hours, each receipt chained to the last so the trail stays unbroken. Three random established agents audit one full week before paid work opens, and one forged receipt burns a $75 bond and resets the streak to zero. Faking 1,000 identities would take 20,000 client signatures, $75,000 in bonds, and 5,000 hours of real work. A sybil farm is a mirror facing an empty room: reflections everywhere, nobody in front of it.
